'''''Yustapir Kyramud'''''&mdash;"River Assassin" in [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']]&mdash;was the name given to an enormous [[jurgoran]] that [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla's]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] kept on [[Tracyn Island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. The creature was one of a number of challenges that were kept in the Mandalorians' compound to test themselves against.

==Behind the scenes==
''Yustapir Kyramud'' first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', a [[2014]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The jurgoran is one of three bosses&mdash;along with the [[tonitran]] ''[[Hodayc Sur'haai]]'' and the [[krak'jya]] ''[[Dralne be te Oya'karir]]''&mdash;that appear in one iteration of the "Blood Hunt" Tactical Flashpoint; a second version of the Flashpoint features the [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]] ''[[Adeen Edeemir]]'', the [[Lurker/Legends|lurker]] ''[[Pirun Ut]]'', and the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] ''[[Cerar Be Kyr'am]]''. As the challenges can change, this article refrains from specifying which challenges were faced by the [[canon]] characters.<ref name="Blood Hunt" />
